## About
SoCal Automotive and Transmissions is a car repair shop at 24002 Via Fabricante in Mission Viejo. Greg owns the shop and works on the cars himself, with his team alongside him.
Reviewers mention a wide mix of vehicles here, from a Saturn Sky Redline and a Honda Odyssey to a Chevy diesel truck and a Jeep Grand Cherokee. The shop holds a 4.9 rating from 46 Google reviews.

## Services
- Transmission service: For one Honda Odyssey with a transmission judder, Greg suggested a fluid change first, the standard procedure Honda recommends, before anything more expensive.
- Clutch work: One reviewer brought in a modified Saturn Sky Redline when the clutch gave out, and Greg's team upgraded it with SPEC performance parts.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: The shop is open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. The shop is closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: You can find us at 24002 Via Fabricante #510, Mission Viejo, CA 92691.

## What customers say
- "The clutch on my moderately modified Saturn Sky Redline finally gave up the ghost. Greg had experience with this type of car, so I trusted him to do the job of upgrading to performance parts made by SPEC. In the process of disassembling the Driveline, we found that the drive shaft, which is no longer available from the OEM source, was damaged. We first tried rebuilding it but it wasn't perfectly balanced so we got a brand new aftermarket one. Through all this, Greg and his team were patient, friendly, extremely careful about marking things, and making sure they were put back in the right place. Greg and SoCal Automotive have my very highest recommendation for honesty, attention to detail, and customer service. Don't hesitate to take your car here no matter the problem!" (Stephen Williams, 5/5)
- "Greg, the owner of SoCal is truly an 'old school' guy, and a great find as a mechanic. He has kept all of our cars running well, whether it was my Chevy 2500 HD diesel, my Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT, my wife's Infiniti 80, my son's Honda Pilot, or my current Lexus GX460. In over 10 years I've never been overcharged, oversold, or received anything but excellent service. And, on top of that Greg is a genuinely nice guy. Look no further." (Bill Bowman, 5/5)
- "I initially took my 04’ Toyota Rav to the dealership and they quoted $800 just for diagnostics! My parents recommended Greg as they have been going to his shop for years and he fixed the issue at a fraction of the cost. I will not be taking my car anywhere besides SoCal Automotive in the future. Automotive repairs can be unforeseen and costly so I am grateful to have a trusted source that is fairly priced and very knowledgeable." (Brooke Legaux, 5/5)
- "Our Honda odyssey transmission judders. Instead of expensive rebuilt, which is often recommended, Greg suggested me to change transmission fluid first, which is the standard procedure recommended by Honda and actually worked. I read horror stories about stores using non- Honda fluid on Honda/Acura. Well, no such concerns here. Always Honda fluid for Honda/Acura. This is a place that I can trust." (Daniel Y, 5/5)
